title: MAGNIFICO: Evaluating the In-Context Learning Ability of Large Language Models to Generalize to Novel Interpretations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance sensitivity to the location of the novel interpretation's description by placing it at the beginning, middle, or end of the prompt's context window or long-form dialogue.

Comparing generalization capabilities across different word forms (plausible English words, foreign/nonsense words, and adversarial words with contrary meanings) to measure the interference of pre-existing semantic priors on learning new interpretations.
